label: Rust performance budgets (criterion)
description: The criterion benchmarks of a Rust crate (cargo bench), compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: criterion in Cargo.toml; runs only where performance is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
